title: Validate and ingest only licence-compatible UEVR-family reference evidence
preflight: Resolve each repository using the exact canonical repository identity; do not substitute mirrors, forks or similarly named repositories.
For UEVR, verify the exact expected head and licence blob if they remain publicly readable. Record URL, head, access state and licence metadata only; do not clone or inventory implementation files.

For UESDK, confirm that anonymous access remains unavailable/restricted. Record that state as evidence only. If it becomes available, stop with EVIDENCE_DRIFT until its exact head and licence are independently classified; do not clone it during this task.
For UEVR Frontend, require repository identity, HEAD SHA and licence blob to match every expected value exactly before any clone or fetch intended for source ingestion.
If any expected repository identity, access state, head, licence blob or permitted-action classification differs, stop with EVIDENCE_DRIFT before source ingestion.
steps: Create the upstream-reference/uevr directory only after preflight succeeds for the exact MIT frontend evidence.
Retain UEVR backend as metadata/link evidence only; never clone it into the durable corpus under this task.
Retain UESDK as metadata/link-only unavailable/restricted evidence; never make its clone an acceptance requirement.
Clone only the UEVR Frontend repository when missing, then checkout exactly dd6d372813097668a67e107c543f513d3170dc7a without silently following a moved branch.

For an existing UEVR Frontend clone, fetch may update remote metadata but must not move the pinned research checkout automatically; revalidate the expected head and MIT licence before using newly fetched material.

Write a manifest containing all three repository URLs, access classifications, expected/observed heads, licence classifications, licence blobs where available, permitted actions, observation date and any blocker.
Generate an implementation file inventory for the exact MIT UEVR Frontend only.
Write derived architecture notes for the restricted backend or unavailable UESDK only as non-expressive observations from permitted evidence; do not copy their source or implementation inventory.
Keep any permitted cloned upstream repository out of normal Stephanos product builds and test discovery.
acceptance: The UEVR backend is recorded as PUBLIC_READABLE_RESTRICTED at the pinned evidence, with no clone and no implementation inventory.
UESDK is recorded as UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE_OR_RESTRICTED or the task stops with EVIDENCE_DRIFT before any attempt to ingest it.
Only UEVR Frontend may be source-ingested, and only when exact head dd6d372813097668a67e107c543f513d3170dc7a and MIT licence blob 566b2a33fcdae086c79da6fc2ec089b96707d8cc are revalidated.
Every upstream has an explicit access status, licence classification, permitted action and evidence date in the manifest.
Any moved head, changed licence blob, changed access state or unknown evidence fails closed as EVIDENCE_DRIFT instead of accepting the new state.
No game assets, restricted backend source, inaccessible UESDK source or unclear third-party profile packages are imported.
